tagline: Building sustainable infrastructure and renewable energy capacity
hero_kpi_rationale: Installed capacity is the primary indicator of structural growth for ACCIONA, reflecting its expansion strategy in renewable energy.

kpis.name: Net Ordinary Investments
kpis.explanation: Amount invested each year in new installations and renewable projects.
kpis.description: Net ordinary capex amounted to €1,538 billion in 2024, primarily directed toward the development of new renewable capacity.
kpis.signal: High capex supports the addition of 2 GW of renewable capacity

kpis.name: Consolidated Revenue
kpis.explanation: Consolidated revenue from all business activities.
kpis.description: Consolidated revenue reached €19,190 billion in 2024, up 12.7% driven by the Infrastructure division and full consolidation of Nordex.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth driven by Infrastructure and Nordex

kpis.name: Consolidated EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization, a key indicator of operational performance.
kpis.description: Consolidated EBITDA reached €2,455 billion in 2024, an increase of 24.0% compared to 2023 (€1,981 billion).
kpis.signal: Strong EBITDA growth driven by Infrastructure and Nordex

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin was 6.86% in 2024 (€1,316 million / €19,190 million), up from 6.37% in 2023.

kpis.name: Net Financial Debt
kpis.explanation: Financial debt after deduction of cash, including IFRS 16 impacts.
kpis.description: Net financial debt (including IFRS 16) amounted to €7,128 billion at end-2024, increasing year-on-year, but the Net Debt/EBITDA ratio improved to 2.90x.
kpis.signal: Debt rising but leverage ratio improving

kpis.name: Net Debt to EBITDA Ratio
kpis.explanation: Key solvency indicator and measure of debt repayment capacity.
kpis.description: The ratio decreased from 3.31x at end-2023 to 2.90x at end-2024, reflecting strong EBITDA generation and improved capital structure.
kpis.signal: Improved financial health despite higher debt

kpis.name: Total Installed Capacity
kpis.explanation: Total power of operational renewable energy assets.
kpis.description: Total installed capacity reached 15,354 GW at end-2024, following the addition of 2 GW of new renewable capacity, with consolidated capacity at 13,630 GW.
kpis.signal: Record addition of 2 GW in 2024, sustainable structural growth

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of EUR 5.284 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of EUR 0.35 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 43.6% in the latest year.

ai_positioning.summary: ACCIONA does not mention any strategy or initiative related to artificial intelligence in the provided documents. The company focuses on green infrastructure, renewable energy, concessions, and renewable asset management.
evidence: No mention of AI or related technologies in the executive summary
Key business segments are renewable energy, infrastructure, and concessions
